title: The full-length interview with Elon Musk | The Economist
why: Zanny pushes the far-right / civil-war charge; Elon talks over to reframe “normal people,” then they stack “let me” / “don’t cut this” before the civil-war quote. Densest overlap in the interview — not the calmer opening abundance stretch.
captionSource: yt-dlp auto-generated English VTT (XuoqKYxDHVc.en.vtt), utterance-grouped; speaker labels inferred from turn-taking and published Economist excerpts.

cues.speaker: Zanny
cues.text: I agree the center of gravity has shifted. The Democratic Party shifted left. But that's not what I'm talking about. I'm talking about people like Rupert Lowe.
cues.note: Restates the far-right charge after Elon's Obama/Hillary riff.

cues.speaker: Elon
cues.text: Please. It's actually just normal people. Secure borders, safe cities, sensible spending — which of those three are far-right fringe?
cues.note: Talks over Zanny mid-name to reframe the parties.

cues.speaker: Elon
cues.text: I would like to just admonish you and the media for the absurd characterization of the far right. It is false and misleading and nonsense. Please keep this part in.
cues.summary: "Far-right" label on normal policies is false
cues.against: Zanny stacks “let me” and reads his civil-war quote

cues.speaker: Zanny
cues.text: We'll keep all of this in. But let me—
cues.note: Tries to take the floor the instant the point lands.

cues.speaker: Elon
cues.text: Don't cut this part.
cues.note: Talks over her “let me” to lock the take.

cues.speaker: Zanny
cues.text: Let me push back on that. You have close to 250 million followers on X.
cues.note: Stacks “let me” while he is still talking.

cues.speaker: Elon
cues.text: Yeah, 'cause I'm a popular guy.
cues.note: Talks over the setup of the quote.

cues.speaker: Zanny
cues.text: Quote: “Civil war in Britain is inevitable. Just a question of when.” When were you last in the UK?
cues.note: Uses the quote to set up the residency challenge.

cues.speaker: Elon
cues.text: A few years ago.
cues.note: Answers the challenge; the claim is not landed yet.

cues.speaker: Zanny
cues.text: Exactly. So I live there the whole time. That is nonsense.
cues.summary: Civil-war claim collapses if you live in Britain
cues.against: Elon: you live in a cloistered existence

cues.speaker: Elon
cues.text: You live in a cloistered existence.

cues.speaker: Zanny
cues.text: No, I don't, actually. And the numbers also disprove what you say.

cues.speaker: Elon
cues.text: What numbers?

cues.speaker: Zanny
cues.text: London is a much safer city than any city in the United States. Violent crime is coming down. Because you have so many followers, Americans believe Europe is overrun — rape on every corner, civilizational destruction.
cues.summary: UK crime is falling; X picture of collapse is false
cues.against: Elon denies the picture, then doubles down on civil war

cues.speaker: Elon
cues.text: I haven't said any of those things.
cues.note: Talks over the end of her picture.

cues.speaker: Zanny
cues.text: Well, you said civil war in Britain is inevitable.
cues.note: Pins him to the quoted line.

cues.speaker: Elon
cues.text: Yes, if current trends continue. A large, rapidly growing group whose beliefs are antithetical to Western beliefs — they will try to implement their views, and those who oppose it will oppose it. That's civil war. You live in a cloistered existence. We can go on a tour of Britain.
cues.summary: Antithetical-belief growth makes UK civil war inevitable
cues.against: Zanny: I live here; you've shaped a false American picture

cues.speaker: Zanny
cues.text: I'd be very happy to tour Britain — the country I live in all the time, and you haven't been in years.
cues.note: Turns the tour offer back on his last visit.

cues.speaker: Elon
cues.text: I've been there literally a hundred times. Literally a few years ago.

cues.speaker: Zanny
cues.text: This exercises me because you've shaped opinion about the UK. Americans I meet think London is dangerous — grooming gangs, violence everywhere. You're posting 48 Hours of Citizen Vigilante. It glorifies vigilante murder of a Muslim immigrant family. Irresponsible to put that on X.
cues.summary: Posting the vigilante film is irresponsible
cues.against: Elon: it's a movie, and it's worth watching

cues.speaker: Elon
cues.text: I think it's a movie, and it's worth watching.
cues.note: Deflects the irresponsible charge without a new claim.

cues.speaker: Zanny
cues.text: You're clearly suggesting Europe is a dystopian place—
cues.note: Cuts back in on the film defense.

cues.speaker: Elon
cues.text: Why aren't you doing more to fight censorship in Europe? People in prison in the UK for social media posts. Do you think that's appropriate?
cues.note: Talks over her dystopia charge with a counter-question.

cues.speaker: Zanny
cues.text: No — we've written editorials against it. I agree. But you don't have to glorify vigilante violence or paint an inaccurate picture of Europe.
cues.summary: Censorship is wrong; the Europe-as-hell picture is still false
cues.against: Elon offers a tour and says he is spot on

cues.speaker: Elon
cues.text: We should do a tour of the UK. There are major problems. I think I'm spot on.
cues.note: Restates the tour and the original claim; no new landing.
